page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Above the text: running head with page number at top right. Below the last line, centred: a gathering signature "C".

main_text.p: Vapor est exhalatio calida & humida, ex aqueo humido potissimùm exsistens.

Fumus est exhalatio calida: aliàs viscosior & hu-miditate aereâ pollens, ac proin facilè inflamma-bilis: aliàs ficcior, ex partibus elementaribus fic-cioribus, in aeream tenuitatem redactis, constàs, non-inflammabilis.
Atq; ita Meteoron quoq; ex aliquo exhalationis genere, in aere ad certam unionem redu-cto, generatur: sive aer ille supra terram sit, sive in cavernosis terræ locis contineatur.
Meteoron ita est vel aqueum, vel non-aqueum.
Aqueum meteoron est, quod ex aqueo vapore ge-neratur.
Estq; primum, vel ex primo ortum.
Primum meteoron aqueum est, quod immediatè ex vapore aqueo, à frigore externo condensato, cō-stat. ut nubes & nebula.
Nubes est meteoron aqueũ, ex vapore aqueo, in media regione aeris, à frigore in densam mo-lem coactum.
Suspenduntur nubes & quasi librantur in ae-re, partim ob propriam levitatem, partim etiam ob aeris continuo ascensu exhalationum agitationem: unde etiam hinc inde in aere circuma-guntur.
Nebula est meteoron aqueũ, ex vapore aqueo levius quàm nubes condensatum.

page.notes: Printed page number "23" at top right is hard to read; the last digit may be a ligature or a printing mark, so it is marked [?]. The word "ita" after "Meteoron" in the line "Meteoron ita est vel aqueum" is overprinted and partly unclear; the reading is doubtful. The running head "AQ" is set with a ligature (Q with a tail carrying a u); transcribed as AQUEIS. Stray marks in the right margin (small strokes beside "redu-" and near "aqueo") are not text and are left out. The signature "C" stands centred at the foot.
